title: Report variants: save settings and verify reopening
goal: Retain a separate filter variant and distinguish it from an immutable result.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 6; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Save a separate personal variant when the command is available.
Explain75→80 when source data changes in a new copy.
sections: A variant retains settings rather than freezing requests. Save a separately named A7 — my customer — minutes for your Alpha. The starter exposes customer/count/minutes; naming a variant cannot add period/status fields. Record the actual code and filter-enabled state.

Do not overwrite the main/shared variant. Use the standard report command to save a new variant, then Выбрать вариант. If this form/edition does not expose personal-variant saving, record that boundary and preserve parameters in your notes; this is not proof of variant persistence.

Close/reopen the report under the same infobase/profile. Compare main and own variants by actual filter, grouping and units rather than title alone. An infobase profile and Nexus account store different state; course self-reports do not replace 1C DCS settings.

In another own copy change one30-minute request to35 and rerun the same variant: Alpha becomes80. That is expected for a saved reference filter. Keep the earlier75 result separately with date/keys. Do not overwrite accepted work to conceal changed input.
